source_row.rationale: Helmet use education emphasizes that properly fitted helmets can help reduce the risk and severity of head injury during falls or impacts associated with activities like cycling or contact sports, an important injury prevention message relevant for recreational participants across all ages, not only professional athletes.
source_row.source_detail: Role of Helmets in Reducing Head Injury Risk
source_row.source_name: CDC — Helmet Use and Head Injury Prevention
